It features a Broadcom BCM43236 dual-band wireless chip. It has 4, 10/100 ethernet ports, and a single 10/100 WAN port. ==Links of Interest== *[http://www.smallnetbuilder.com/wireless/wireless-reviews/31578-cisco-linksys-e2500-advanced-dual-band-n-router-reviewed Reviewed on '''SmallNetBuilder'''] :"3763-30000302R" or "3763-30000303R" is silkscreened on the board. *[http://www.dd-wrt.com/phpBB2/viewtopic.php?t=138322 Linksys/Cisco E2500 for DD-WRT] On the '''DD-WRT''' forums *[http://www.dd-wrt.com/phpBB2/viewtopic.php?t=90346 New Linksys Router (E1200; E1500; E2500; E3200)] On the '''DD-WRT''' forums *[http://www.dd-wrt.com/phpBB2/viewtopic.php?t=140536 On the '''DD-WRT''' forums] :C0:C1:C0 OUI and 300MHz CPU in the boot log The E2500v1 would [http://tomato.groov.pl/?page_id=69 appear to be experimentally supported by ''Shibby'''s '''Tomato''' RT-N builds]. The E2500v1 is [http://victek.is-a-geek.com] supported.
